title: Log-space membership of the path languages
statement: For each $j\in\{0,1\}$, the language that, on an input encoding a bit string $x$ and an integer $i$, tests whether the $i$th bit of $x$ is $1$ when $j=0$, and whether $i<|x|$ when $j=1$, is decidable in logarithmic space up to a constant factor.
